name: DOC_INFORMATION_3
description: The DOC_INFORMATION table contains information about documents, including scanned and electronically signed documents.

columns.name: DOCUMENT_ID
columns.description: The unique identifier (.1 item) for the document record.

columns.name: CREATED_BY_SYSTEM_C_NAME
columns.description: The system that this document originated from. This is set on a document in a document batch that was created from directory sweep. The source system comes from the directory sweep extension.
